mapper.select: SELECT id, activity_name AS activityName, activity_type AS activityType, valid_from AS validFrom, valid_to AS validTo, rule FROM xsy_promotion_activity WHERE deleted = FALSE AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND valid_from <= #{at} AND valid_to > #{at} ORDER BY priority DESC, id ASC LIMIT 30

SELECT c.id AS couponId, c.coupon_name AS couponName, c.discount_type AS discountType, c.discount_value AS discountValue, c.min_order_amount AS minOrderAmount, c.valid_from AS validFrom, c.valid_to AS validTo, c.per_customer_limit AS perCustomerLimit, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM xsy_promotion_coupon_instance i WHERE i.coupon_id = c.id AND i.customer_id = #{customerId} AND i.issue_source = #{claimSource}) AS claimedByCustomer, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM xsy_promotion_coupon_instance i WHERE i.coupon_id = c.id AND i.issue_source = #{claimSource}) AS claimedTotal FROM xsy_promotion_coupon c WHERE c.deleted = FALSE AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.claimable = TRUE AND c.valid_from <= #{at} AND c.valid_to > #{at} ORDER BY c.id DESC
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN i.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.valid_to <= #{at} THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN i.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND (c.deleted = TRUE OR c.status <> 'ACTIVE' OR c.valid_from > #{at}) THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' ELSE i.status END
